stem: The expression \(3(x + 4) - (x - 2)\) is equivalent to \(ax + b\), where \(a\) and \(b\) are constants. What is the value of \(b\)?
solution: Distribute: \(3x + 12 - x + 2\). The negative sign changes \(-2\) to \(+2\).
verify:
x = symbols('x')
p = Poly(expand(3*(x + 4) - (x - 2)), x)
assert p.coeff_monomial(1) == 14
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [14]
